entities.summary: Ralph Nelson Elliott was an American accountant and author whose study of stock market data led him to develop the Wave Principle, a description of the cyclical nature of trader psychology and a form of technical analysis. These cyclical patterns in price movements are known among practitioners of the method as Elliott waves.
